breaking_news.headline: U.S. job market slows in June
breaking_news.summary: Employers added 57,000 jobs in June, the Labor Department said on Friday, as jobs growth slowed from the previous two months, while the unemployment rate ticked down to 4.2%.

breaking_news.headline: Trump earned more than $1 billion from crypto — but his investors didn't fare so well
breaking_news.summary: President Trump earned more than $1 billion in 2025 from cryptocurrency ventures. But there are thousands of investors who bought into some of those cryptocurrencies, and they stand to lose big.

breaking_news.headline: A hot summer trend in the sharing economy? Rental swimming pools
breaking_news.summary: Don't have a pool during this hot summer? Rent one! Swimply is a platform that lets users rent private pools.

breaking_news.headline: A hot summer trend in the sharing economy? Rental swimming pools
breaking_news.summary: The Airbnb-style company Swimply said there have been about 275,000 private pool reservations so far this year.

breaking_news.headline: But first, coffee: The drink that energized the American Revolution
breaking_news.summary: Colonial Americans were drinking coffee long before they dumped tea into Boston Harbor or fought a war for independence. The establishments that served it were already brewing revolutionary ideas.

breaking_news.headline: Egg producers settle with DOJ, states over price-fixing complaint
breaking_news.summary: Seventeen states and the Department of Justice have settled a case of alleged price-fixing by major egg producers. Egg prices soared in recent years but have since fallen sharply.

breaking_news.headline: Hate food waste? 7 creative ways to turn your leftovers into a new meal
breaking_news.summary: We asked our audience to share their favorite go-to recipes for leftovers. Here are seven dishes — like stuffed peppers and a biryani casserole — that can help you use up all your fridge scraps.

breaking_news.headline: Meet 'Project 2029' — and its war on the annoyance economy
breaking_news.summary: Remember Project 2025? Democrats are building their own governing blueprint, and one proposal takes aim at the "annoyance economy": robocalls, endless hold times, hidden fees and other everyday frustrations.

breaking_news.headline: Bomb explosions injure 18 in Damascus during Macron's visit
breaking_news.summary: As reports of the blasts came in, state television said the Syrian president had welcomed Macron at the presidential palace.

breaking_news.headline: Watch: Moment rare tornado lashes central Chinese cities
breaking_news.summary: Videos shared with the BBC show debris flying through the air as the storm swept through Ezhou and Huanggang in Hubei province.

breaking_news.headline: Ghana halts visit by South African president amid row over anti-migrant protests
breaking_news.summary: Many in Ghana feared his presence would lead to mass protests, and officials say it is postponed for now.

breaking_news.headline: Jailers and officials at Russia's 'torture prisons' in Ukraine exposed by BBC
breaking_news.summary: Former prisoners accuse the men of abuse in detention centres and want to see them brought to trial.

breaking_news.headline: Lawyer says detained Gaza doctor was severely beaten in Israeli jail
breaking_news.summary: The lawyer for Dr Hussam Abu Safiya tells the BBC his client was so badly beaten he could not recognise him during a visit last week.

breaking_news.headline: Woman suspected of Monaco bomb attack found dead in Ukraine
breaking_news.summary: Police had been hunting Anastasiia Berezovska after a Ukrainian millionaire was injured in the blast.

breaking_news.headline: Zelensky presses Nato for air defence systems after intense Russian strikes
breaking_news.summary: The Ukrainian president says "decisions for air defence" should be "one of the key outcomes" of this week's summit in Turkey.

breaking_news.headline: Marine Le Pen found guilty, but court clears way for presidential run if she wears tag
breaking_news.summary: The National Rally leader now has to decide whether she will run with an electronic tag and will speak on TV later.

breaking_news.headline: Phone contract comparisons 'amounted to mis-selling' student loans, MPs say
breaking_news.summary: A new report says students were not well-enough informed that their loan terms could change retrospectively.

breaking_news.headline: Samsung profits jump 1,800% as AI chip sales soar
breaking_news.summary: The firm's shares fell sharply on Tuesday as some investors had expected an even stronger performance.

breaking_news.headline: Robots available for rent: But what can they do?
breaking_news.summary: Robotics tech is changing fast, so for many it makes sense to rent a robot.

breaking_news.headline: 'I wear it on my middle finger': The rise of the defiant divorce ring
breaking_news.summary: Around the world women are marking their split with new - or repurposed engagement - rings.
